_purpose: Package N Step B. Airtable Web API create-table payload for the existing PlotNua base (POST /v0/meta/bases/{baseId}/tables). Create ONLY with founder approval. 19 fields (founder decision 26 Nov 2026: supplier_slug, consent_at and reviewer removed). The Worker writes with typecast:false, so names and choices must match exactly (proved by prove-introduction.mjs I56). The first field is the primary field.

table.name: Introduction Requests
table.description: PlotNua introduction requests (Package N). Rows are deleted automatically the day after delete_after unless retain_reason is set.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: UTC time the request was received; also the moment of consent.

fields.name: supplier_name
fields.description: Empty for a general request. For a supplier request, the unique allow-listed trading name the homeowner agreed to.

fields.name: consent_text_hash
fields.description: SHA-256 of the exact sentence agreed to. General: the general sentence. Supplier: the supplier sentence naming supplier_name. Verifiable from this record alone.

fields.name: delete_after
fields.description: created + 12 months. The Worker deletes the row the day after, unless retain_reason is set.

fields.name: test_record
fields.description: Ticked while the public route is closed.

fields.name: retain_reason
fields.description: Fill ONLY to stop automatic deletion (active request; legal or accounting record). Clear it when the reason ends.
